name: bounded-dev-cycle
description: A bounded Scout → Plan → Build development workflow for repository work, with read-only reconnaissance, PLAN_READY handoff, human approval, and tightly scoped verified implementation.

interface.longDescription: Run repository development through strict read-only Scout reconnaissance, one PLAN_READY planning pass, human approval of the exact plan identity, and one tightly scoped verified Build execution.
defaultPrompt: Run one bounded Scout → Plan → Build repository cycle. Invoke scout-agent first and keep it read-only. Invoke plan exactly once using the completed Scout handoff. Do not invoke build-agent until the exact PLAN_READY identity has been reviewed and approved by the human. Then invoke build-agent exactly once using only that approved PLAN_READY artifact. Stop on any blocked or failed gate.
